section.name: Introduction
section.p: In most cases, the implementation of HtmlUnit follows a test-driven development (TDD) approach.

To stay in sync with the behavior of real browsers, we write tests that compare execution results from real browsers against HtmlUnit's results. This directly leads to a test-first approach: write the test, run it across real browsers to adjust expectations, execute it against HtmlUnit, and fix the underlying implementation as needed. Additionally, we keep tests as concise as possible to maintain a direct connection between a test failure and its underlying code.
The central class powering this workflow is WebDriverTestCase. Please refer to the JavaDoc for details on switching between real browser drivers and HtmlUnit when executing your test suite.
